chemistry-killer-07.title: Mole
chemistry-killer-07.goal: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.
chemistry-killer-07.material: Pa standard temperature and pressure (STP, 0 °C, 1 atm; 1 mol yegasi = 22.4 L), sanganiswa yemagasi emethane ($\mathrm{CH_4}$) necarbon dioxide ($\mathrm{CO_2}$) ine vhoriyamu ye 11.2 L uye huremu hwe 16.4 g. Atomic masses ndi H = 1, C = 12, O = 16, uye nhamba yaAvogadro ndi $N_A$. Pane maatomu mangani ose musanganiswa uyu?
chemistry-killer-07.s.s1.prompt: Pa standard temperature and pressure (STP, 0 °C, 1 atm; 1 mol yegasi = 22.4 L), sanganiswa yemagasi emethane ($\mathrm{CH_4}$) necarbon dioxide ($\mathrm{CO_2}$) ine vhoriyamu ye 11.2 L uye huremu hwe 16.4 g. Atomic masses ndi H = 1, C = 12, O = 16, uye nhamba yaAvogadro ndi $N_A$. Pane maatomu mangani ose musanganiswa uyu?
chemistry-killer-07.s.s1.explain:
Nhanho 1: Mamole ose = 11.2 L / 22.4 L/mol = 0.5 mol, saka x + y = 0.5.
Nhanho 2: Huremu: 16x + 44y = 16.4. Tsiva y = 0.5 - x: 16x + 22 - 44x = 16.4, saka 28x = 5.6, x = 0.2, y = 0.3.
Nhanho 3: Maatomu: $\mathrm{CH_4}$ ine maatomu 5 pamolecule imwe, 0.2 x 5 = 1.0 mol; $\mathrm{CO_2}$ ine 3, 0.3 x 3 = 0.9 mol. Huwandu hwose 1.9 mol yemaatomu = $1.9\,N_A$.
Pindura: $1.9\,N_A$ (c). (Sarudzo dzisiri dzakarurama: 1.5 inotora kuti ose ndeeCO2, 2.5 inotora kuti ose ndeeCH4, 1.7 inoverenga maatomu 4 chete eCH4.)
chemistry-killer-07.s.s2.prompt: Which scenario demonstrates the correct real-world application of this principle?
chemistry-killer-07.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.
